title: Enter carbs  externally via nightscout
symptom: Carbs entered externally via Nightscout do not appear in AAPS and are not considered in the loop, despite Nightscout client showing treatments received correctly.
cause: The user did not have engineering mode enabled and proper NSClient settings, which are required for the feature to work.
fix: Enable engineering mode and configure proper NSClient settings as described in the release notes for version 2.8.1.1.
evidence_quote: you don't have enabled engineering mode and proper NSClient settings
